note: Reviewed realignment of the meanings published for the Ramayana and Rig Veda when both were rebuilt from the full DharmicData text (2026-10-25). Keys are old positions "chapter:number" in the 82-entry Ramayana and 67-entry Rig Veda files; values are the verse's new position, or null when the quoted Sanskrit is not that verse of this text. A meaning is carried only where the quoted Sanskrit is the same verse (sandhi or spelling aside) or one literal half of it. Repeats of one verse all map to it; the first keeps its meaning. Used by scripts/seed-ramayana.ts and scripts/seed-vedas.ts (--realign), by scripts/realign-verse-keys.ts, and for the 301s in public/_redirects.
